title: Signature Hillside Pantry Vault
body:
Signature Hillside Pantry Vault is an original Signature design for a hillside food store with a planted roof, a ventilated entry porch, and terraced shelving sized for a year's preserves. Its Signature feature is a harvest ledger wall where every stored batch is chalked with its date, so rotation is visible at a glance.
